notes: This screen was originally built without going through the skill at all (a bare uni.module.css .panel — floating rounded card, heavy shadow, 520px centered — dropped into an empty page) and the user called it out directly as looking like 'a worthless modal ui,' pointing at real launchpad/trading-terminal references (a purple portfolio dashboard, Coinbase Prime's trading terminal). Rebuilt per component-patterns.md's App shell section. Key fix: WalletAccountV6Tag (the shared trading/launch action component, business logic untouched) now takes a chrome prop — 'shell' is the new flush/integrated skin used everywhere in /dashboard; 'embed' (the original floating-card skin) stays as the default but, checked against actual usage, nothing currently renders the component outside /dashboard, so it's an honestly-unused alternate skin, not something still live on the landing page. Also fixed a real bug surfaced during live verification: initialTab on WalletAccountV6Tag only seeds useState on mount, so clicking a launch round's row while already on the Launches section didn't actually switch tabs until a key={launchInitialTab} was added to force a remount. Also fixed a focus-scroll bug: a trailing 'Open' button in the launches table's last column caused the browser to scroll the table's horizontal-overflow container to bring the focused button into view on click, hiding the first (Round) column — fixed by making the whole row the click target instead (removes both the overflow-inducing column and the focus target), not by fighting the browser's default focus-scroll behavior. anti_slop_scan.py and audit_motion.py both pass clean on src/app/dashboard/.
